proposed_comments.title: Keep pinned access keys stable when recents come first

confidence.rationale: ComposeSections currently derives both shortcut ranges from result.Count, so placing recent items first deterministically renumbers every pinned item.

proposed_comments.title: Reserve configured pins beyond the display limit

confidence.rationale: The early break at the visible pin limit prevents later configured pins from entering either ownership set.

proposed_comments.body:
### Reserve configured pins beyond the display limit

**Severity:** `medium`

`ResolvePinnedCommands` stops scanning as soon as the visible pin limit is reached. A configured pin after that point is therefore not reserved, so the same command can be promoted from history into Recent even though it is still configured as pinned. Scan every configured pin to reserve its identity, while adding only the first `effectivePinnedCommandLimit` resolved pins to the visible list, and cover the zero/over-limit cases in the resolver tests.

proposed_comments.title: Keep pinned commands in the pinned section

confidence.rationale: The recent-first branch resolves history before pins, so a command present in both sets is claimed by Recent before the pinned pass runs.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep pinned commands in the pinned section

**Severity:** `medium`

Resolving Recent before Pinned changes ownership rather than presentation: a configured pin that also appears in history is consumed by Recent and then omitted from Pinned. The feature contract says recent items are unpinned, regardless of whether the section is shown before or after Pinned. Resolve and reserve pinned identities first, resolve recents second, and use the placement setting only when composing the already-owned sections.

proposed_comments.title: Normalize invalid persisted placement values

confidence.rationale: The settings model accepts undefined numeric enum values while Home, shelf, and ComboBox consumers interpret them differently.

proposed_comments.body:
### Normalize invalid persisted placement values

**Severity:** `medium`

The two init-only `RecentCommandsPlacement` properties accept any integer from persisted JSON. A malformed, transient `-1`, or future value can consequently enable recents on Home, hide them on the shelf, and leave the settings ComboBox with an invalid selection. Normalize both properties to `Hidden`, `BeforePinned`, or `AfterPinned` at the settings boundary and add serialization coverage for invalid values.

proposed_comments.title: Enforce the shelf-specific five-item limit

confidence.rationale: CreateConfiguration clamps against the shared maximum of 10 even though the PR description explicitly limits the compact shelf to five recent items.

proposed_comments.body:
### Enforce the shelf-specific five-item limit

**Severity:** `medium`

The shelf currently accepts the shared Home limit of 10, although the PR contract says the compact shelf appends at most five recent items. Clamp the shelf configuration independently so a valid Home setting cannot overfill the shelf.

```suggestion
            Math.Clamp(
                recentCommandLimit,
                SettingsModel.MinRecentCommandsDisplayLimit,
                5));
```

proposed_comments.title: Describe the stable pinned shortcut order

confidence.rationale: The current resource promises left-to-right numbering, which conflicts with the PR's stated stable pinned-order behavior whenever recents precede pins.

proposed_comments.body:
### Describe the stable pinned shortcut order

**Severity:** `low`

The current description says shortcuts follow visual left-to-right order, which conflicts with stable pinned shortcuts when Recent is placed first. Describe the ownership rule instead.

```suggestion
    <value>Shows quick access commands below the search box while compact mode is collapsed. Pinned commands keep Alt+1 through Alt+9 in pinned order, recent commands use any remaining shortcuts, and Alt+0 opens overflow.</value>
```

> If applying both suggestions in this resource file individually, apply the lower-line suggestion first or batch them atomically.

proposed_comments.title: Clarify that the shelf stops at five recent items

confidence.rationale: The current text says the selected 1-10 value applies to the shelf, while the stated shelf contract has a five-item maximum.

proposed_comments.body:
### Clarify that the shelf stops at five recent items

**Severity:** `low`

The setting currently says the selected 1-10 limit applies equally to Home and the shelf. Clarify the shelf-specific cap so the UI describes the implemented behavior.

```suggestion
    <value>Choose how many recently used commands and launched apps, from 1 through 10, can appear on Home. The quick access shelf shows at most five.</value>
```

> If applying both suggestions in this resource file individually, apply this lower-line suggestion first or batch them atomically.
